title: Jovial Umami Australian Chestnut Roast
description: A savory and adventurous Australian dish featuring roasted chestnuts, score-fat, and umami flavors, low in sodium and perfect for a special occasion. This recipe combines the richness of chestnuts with the depth of umami, creating a truly unique taste experience.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the chopped chestnuts with the melted score-fat, olive oil, garlic, and onion until they are evenly coated.
Spread the chestnut mixture in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast for 20 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the mushroom broth, dried thyme, and black pepper.
After the chestnuts have roasted for 20 minutes, pour the broth mixture over them and continue to roast for an additional 15 minutes.
Remove the chestnuts from the oven and let them cool slightly before serving.
Serve the roasted chestnuts hot, garnished with fresh thyme if desired.
To enhance the umami flavor, serve the chestnuts with a side of roasted meats or vegetables.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
